title: Oven Baked Ukrainian Mackerel Pilaf
description: A herbal and indulgent Ukrainian dish featuring mackerel, this pilaf is a hearty meal option, shojin-friendly and air-fry inspired for a healthier twist.

ingredients.name: mackerel fillets
ingredients.notes: canned in water, drained and flaked

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the rice, water, olive oil, thyme, salt, and pepper, and mix well.
In a separate pan, saute the chopped onion and grated carrots over medium heat until they are tender.
Add the sauteed onion and carrots to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Flake the mackerel into the rice mixture and stir gently to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and stir in the lemon juice.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
